symptom: Adding a Codex API key in Settings still failed the next message with "Your access token could not be refreshed because your refresh token was revoked": the restarted app-server received OPENAI_API_KEY but authenticated with the device ChatGPT login in ~/.codex/auth.json.
rule: Qualify how a provider binary reads credentials against the executable Zeros launches, not a mocked runtime. Codex's app-server ignores OPENAI_API_KEY and CODEX_API_KEY, so a selected key is logged in through account/login/start with an ephemeral credential store, and an API selection without a key stays signed out.
